title: Through Five Art Styles
description: Five painting references guide a continuous shot through several visual styles.
review: Follow the direction of the camera across each change in the visual style.
Watch whether the main action carries through the change in color and texture.

title: Into the Giant Flower World
description: A character moves through three flower-filled scenes guided by reference images. Sand.ai publishes a reference sheet on the source page.
review: Compare the character's outfit with the reference sheet in both wide and close shots.
Watch how leaves and petals obscure the frame during transitions.

title: Precision Timeline & Shot-Cut Control
description: Sand.ai demonstrates script-level control over when shots start, how long they hold and what event triggers a cut.
review: Mark the visible cuts on a timeline and compare how long each shot holds.
Look for actions that carry across the edit and actions that start after the cut.

title: From “Preview” to “MAGI-2”
description: A text-guided edit turns the cursor of an existing screen recording into an eraser and transforms the webpage background on the way to a title card.
review: Watch how the cursor and the word being erased move relative to each other.
Pause on the final title and check which text remains legible.

title: Cinematic Quality, Close-Up Ready
description: Sand.ai's first homepage capability clip highlights lighting and fine textures at close range.
review: Compare the detail on lit and shaded surfaces in the tightest frames.
Watch whether fine features remain stable as the shot moves.

title: Studio-Quality Ads, Without the Studio
description: This homepage capability clip presents MAGI-2 in a commercial production context, emphasizing lighting and product surfaces.
review: Check what the passing highlights reveal about the material.
Compare the product silhouette in different frames for changes in shape.

title: Every Character, a Method Actor
description: Sand.ai's character-performance slide focuses on small changes in facial expression and body language.
review: Watch the eyes and eyebrows as the person's expression changes.
Look at how posture and head movement support the change in expression.

title: Boat Dialogue Between Lu Su and Zhuge Liang
description: A pre-training experiment with prompt enhancement turned off. Sand.ai supplied character and scene references plus three story beats and let the model choose the shots.
review: Watch how the camera changes perspective between the two speakers.
Check how the listening character reacts before and after speaking.

title: Alpine Lake — After Reinforcement Learning
description: The after-training half of Sand.ai's published Alpine Lake comparison. The source page pairs it with the corresponding earlier model output.
review: Select Alpine Lake on the source page and compare the same moment on both sides of the slider.
Look at edges, texture and lighting changes as the image moves.

title: 9×9 Sudoku Probe
prompt: Solve this 9×9 Sudoku puzzle step by step, filling each empty cell one by one while keeping all given digits unchanged.
description: Sand.ai asked a pre-trained model, with prompt enhancement off, to complete a Sudoku grid on screen. This is a documented probe of one checkpoint.
review: Pause on the starting and final boards to check that the original digits are retained.
Check rows, columns and 3×3 boxes on the last board rather than relying on the drawing animation.
